title: SREV-184 XP file open packet offset contract
contracts: file_xp.c owns the 32-bit Windows XP and Windows 2003 file and device parse-procedure hook
OPEN_PACKET is a private local layout mirror used only by the XP parse-procedure path
File_CreateMyContext may read CreateOptions Options and CreateDisposition only after Context Type equals IO_TYPE_OPEN_PACKET
expected 32-bit OPEN_PACKET offsets are CreateOptions 0x20 Options 0x30 and CreateDisposition 0x34
the offsets are compile-time gates through FIELD_OFFSET and changing the local OPEN_PACKET layout must fail the source gate
Vista and later use the minifilter route so this XP parse hook must not claim Vista Windows 7 or Windows 8 context layout compatibility
ACCESS_STATE OriginalDesiredAccess is read as the original requested access rights and is not modified
this SREV does not change file or device parse-procedure routing policy decisions IO_OPEN_TARGET_DIRECTORY handling font token handling or minifilter behavior
runtime_gate: Windows XP/2003 32-bit driver build with XP_SUPPORT, XP file and device parse-procedure hook smoke, file open and rename smoke, and Vista+ minifilter route smoke
